hook: Several of *105* Young India schools to open next academic year
hook_b: Several of *105* Young India schools to open next academic year
tldr: Bhatti Vikramarka said construction is moving fast, speaking at a Telangana Public School foundation event in Kazipet.

beats.what: The State sanctioned 105 Young India Integrated Residential Schools; several should open from the next academic year.
beats.why: The government says it wants quality schooling regardless of a child's socio-economic background.
beats.care: Separately, Telangana Public Schools (one per constituency) will be semi-residential, English-medium, pre-primary to Class 12.

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: The Hindu: Telangana Public School students would get breakfast, lunch, uniforms, books and transport, and go home in the evening.

cards.q: Fully residential or semi-residential: which works better for kids?

qs: How will students be selected for the first Young India schools?
Which constituencies get the first schools?

facts.t: Separately, *one* Telangana Public School is sanctioned per Assembly constituency, pre-primary to Class 12.

watch: How many of the 105 schools are actually ready for the 2027-28 session.

sources.name: The Hindu
sources.title: Young India Residential Schools to be ready from next academic year

fact: Telangana plans to open several of its *105* Young India residential schools next year.
twist: Each school is sanctioned at an estimated *₹200 crore*, Deputy CM Bhatti Vikramarka said.
